title: Tried to like it
body: I really tried to make the best of this app, but it was an overall painful experience. Right off the bat, this app cannot be used for essential daily reminders such as medications such as medications and supplements. If you forget to check off an individual item one day, even if it’s set as a daily reminder, it will no longer remind you about that item. As you check off tasks, tasks get moved into the completed section while recurring reminders fill in the list again, making accidentally a very common issue. In fact, even setting up a reminder is far too confusing. The companion app on Windows is also terrible, as items often fall out of sync as you have to wait a good 5 minutes for either device to realise a task has been checked off or added. Not recommended at all.
